title: Fossil of 'unconquered female warrior' dinosaur with long claws found in UK museum drawer after 100 years
caption:
A 100-year-old museum mystery has been solved. Researchers identified a forgotten fossil as a new species of megaraptoran, providing the first evidence that these clawed predators once lived in Europe.

Source: Livescience - Fossil of 'unconquered female warrior' dinosaur with long claws found in UK museum drawer after 100 years
